name: talewisp
description: Writing and editing companion for Google Docs, linked story context and Obsidian vaults.

interface.shortDescription: Write and edit with your voice and story context.
interface.longDescription: A writing companion for Google Docs and Obsidian. Reads text and author comments, defaults manuscript revisions to native suggestions with accept/reject, requires text-anchored review comments, and connects plot notes and character states through Google Sheets. Unsupported native operations are reported unfinished. Google cloud operations require the Google Drive connector; canon and style profiles stay under author control.
defaultPrompt: Прочитай мой Google документ и комментарии, опиши сцену и предложи точечные правки.
Предложи правку выделенного фрагмента в нативном режиме Советовать.
Продолжи сцену в выбранном авторском стиле, сверившись с сюжетными заметками и состоянием героя.
Свяжи эту сцену с сюжетной таблицей и заметками.
Создай базу по этим книгам, документам и заметкам.
Meet me as an author, ask a short adaptive questionnaire, and recommend whether to begin with style, series, or book setup.
Calibrate my style with short action, description, and dialogue scenes, learning from my edits.
Continue my current scene while preserving its voice and canon.
Check this chapter for continuity errors and cite the sources.
Edit the selected passage and show a reviewable revision.
